description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing the daily operations of the nursing department, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care and maintaining regulatory compliance. You will play a key role in staff supervision, development, and the implementation of best practices to foster a compassionate and efficient care environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated nursing professional looking to advance their leadership career within a supportive setting. We are looking for someone passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents, contributing to a positive team culture, and upholding the highest standards of care. If you are ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding position, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Previous experience in a supervisory or leadership role within a healthcare setting
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and standards
Ability to lead and mentor nursing staff effectively
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 to $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
